title: How do you decide which SEC filings are worth opening
author: catalyst-radar
selftext:
**For traders who follow a watchlist: when a new SEC filing appears, how do you decide whether it deserves your attention?**

**I’m building Catalyst Radar, an iOS app that monitors filings and earnings events for selected tickers and surfaces potentially meaningful events with concise summaries and links to the original SEC source.**

**I’m trying to learn where a tool like this helps—and where it might add noise. Which filing types or event details make you click through? What would you rather filter out?**

**Disclosure: I’m the developer. I’m asking for candid workflow feedback, not investment advice.**
